invariants: No required SentinelX/Desktop Commander/Codex runtime dependency
Native agent uses outbound Nexowire-owned transport
Ambiguous mutations are not blindly replayed
GitHub main and tests override stale handoff prose

priorities.summary: Opt-in sidecar-owned durable process stdin/stdout/stderr reattaches across native-agent restart; bounded output spool and Windows/Linux CI coverage
Task-graph artifact metadata/hashes persist without contents; bounded list and re-verification primitives detect verified/changed/missing/unverified/error states
Persistent device directory, aliases, groups, capability-aware discovery, deterministic named route policies, and multi-device routing are implemented

Native protocol v2 identifies process instances; same-process reconnects resume exact request IDs through bounded dedupe cache, read-only work may resume after process restart, and pending mutations fail unknown instead of replaying across instance change
First-party relay server, ordered direct/relay endpoint fallback, inbound/upstream authentication, bounded forwarding/backpressure/heartbeats, and real native-agent relay CI are implemented
Per-device capability policies, a separate elevated Windows broker, DPAPI CurrentUser-protected broker authentication, and highest-privilege per-user scheduled-task lifecycle are implemented

Direct TLS, rotating/revocable/expiring auth, roles/scopes, external OIDC/JWT identity, protected secret sources, redacted backend status, deployment doctor, guided hash-only onboarding/bootstrap, live HTTPS/OIDC/revocation CI, and safe stdin-backed read-verified macOS Keychain writes are implemented

Stored credential authorization filters tools/list and calls; HTTP MCP discovery filters native-backed schemas by online agent capabilities; browser advertisements are executable-aware and wsl.exec is advertised only when an installed distro is detected
Reusable bounded read-only file/process/TCP/HTTP postcondition assertion workflows are implemented

Real Linux native-agent/relay integration runs in Ubuntu CI, real Ubuntu 24.04 WSL2 verifies Nexowire wsl.exec on Windows CI, and real macOS native-agent core CI verifies outbound transport plus machine/shell/file/process execution
Bounded persistent payload-free audit history query with capability/status/target/provider/operation/time filters

Higher-level durable runbooks now compose persistent task-graph and read-only assertion stages with dependency DAGs, bounded parallelism, payload-free checkpoints, exact-spec resume, safe automatic replay of interrupted read-only assertions, and explicit retry for unknown task state

MCP surface v1 has a stable tool-name floor, frozen backward-compatible input contracts, and a machine-readable frozen structured-output semantic contract with canonical hash and surface discovery metadata

The v1 skill-library baseline is complete: manifest v1+v2, validation, device-aware runnability, capability alternatives/preferences, replay/concurrency metadata, 45 shipped workflows, fourteen replay-safe parallel read-only v2 workflows, seven conservative domain recipes, and CI-enforced documentation/capability/read-only contracts; further recipes are post-v1 incremental additions

First-party normal native-agent lifecycle is implemented across Windows current-user Scheduled Task, Linux systemd user service, and macOS per-user LaunchAgent with install/status/start/stop/restart/uninstall/autostart, plaintext-secret persistence refusal, and real macOS CI coverage

Nexowire 1.0.0 release readiness is implemented: installable CLI packaging, bundled-skill lookup, deterministic package audits, clean tarball smoke on Linux/Windows/macOS, SHA256SUMS, release manifest, CycloneDX SBOM, independent verification, exact tag enforcement, SLSA/CycloneDX attestations, and an explicit authorization-marker GitHub Release gate; npm remains disabled for the initial release

Live self-host bootstrap is complete on DESKTOP-ONDD84S with Hub+Agent autostart, stable device identity, protected credentials, healthy Tailscale Serve/Funnel, and exact main 594a6a81 running after Hub/Agent restart. Hosted control-plane deployment is now live; remaining work is ChatGPT-side OAuth MCP connector acceptance.

Hosted control plane, ChatGPT Web OAuth MCP acceptance, Free-plan production acceptance, and the Lemon Squeezy Plus/Pro billing core are complete. PR #178 added hosted checkout, signed subscription webhooks, customer portal URLs, D1 billing state/idempotency, dashboard controls, and DPAPI-capable billing secret sources. Migration 0007 and Worker version b5495420-951e-4122-9cd9-df2b012c6528 are live with billing intentionally disabled until real provider configuration is supplied. Remaining work is Custom/prepaid funded-credit payments, live Lemon Squeezy activation/acceptance, and the separate GitHub Actions Cloudflare deployment-auth gap.

NexowirePrivate now has isolated app/window hosting, exact private-HWND pointer routing, Unicode text/hotkey routing, bounded hidden-screen capture, a local heartbeat-backed read-only viewer with explicit local entry/return UX, and time-bounded local grants for physical-console mutations.

notes: Use independent branches/worktrees for parallel slices.
Update this file after major merges that materially change remaining work.
Do not infer completion from chat history; inspect main and CI.
The first-party relay path is verified with a real native agent in Ubuntu CI.
Development access through SentinelX/RDC is temporary tooling only and never counts as runtime implementation.
Durable runbooks are the preferred higher-level orchestration primitive; do not add new step kinds unless restart/replay semantics are explicit and tested.
MCP surface v1 is the compatibility floor; additive tools are allowed, but stable tool removal/rename requires a new surface version and migration path.
Shipped skills declare platform/mutation/privilege/trust/tags; skills_list can evaluate missing capabilities against an exact online device.
Stable v1 input schemas are frozen in src/mcp/v1-input-contract.json; regenerate only after explicit compatibility review.
Shipped skill manifests are CI-validated as a library contract.
npm run continuation:check validates PROJECT_STATE.json, required continuation files, hot-file references, unique/sorted priorities, and the HANDOFF resume contract.
Stable v1 structured-output semantics are frozen in src/mcp/v1-output-contract.json; regenerate only after explicit compatibility review.
OIDC/JWT external MCP identity is merged and maps into existing Nexowire role/tool/device/route authorization; do not treat it as active unfinished work.
Deployment doctor is merged and reports local/remote readiness, TLS validity, auth posture, secret-source mechanisms, OIDC posture, and state-directory health without printing credentials.
Live security CI now starts a real HTTPS hub and local OIDC provider, verifies scoped discovery and live stored-credential revocation, and confirms plaintext credentials are not persisted.
Guided deployment onboarding/bootstrap is merged: plan mode is non-mutating; bootstrap issues missing hash-only credentials and emits plaintext tokens once without persisting them.
event-driven-control is manifest v2 but deliberately mixed/serial/manual-replay because it includes process.start; do not reclassify it replay-safe merely because its observation phase is read-only.

macOS Keychain create/update is now first-party and verified in real macOS CI using security -q -i with the mutation command on stdin, explicit overwrite semantics, bounded execution, and read-back verification; plaintext secrets are not placed in process argv.
Windows native agents now advertise wsl.exec only when bounded wsl.exe distro discovery finds at least one installed distro; machine.snapshot reuses the same detector.

The shipped skill library contains 45 workflows. Fourteen read-only manifest-v2 workflows are explicitly parallel-safe/replay-safe; mixed workflows retain verify/manual replay semantics, and configuration-drift-audit is the seventh conservative domain recipe.
Shipped-skill CI verifies that docs/SKILLS.md exactly indexes the validated on-disk skill library.
Domain-recipe CI rejects unknown required/alternative/preferred capability references and rejects read-only domain recipes that reference capabilities outside READ_ONLY_CAPABILITIES.

Real macOS native-agent core CI now verifies outbound transport, capability advertisement, machine snapshot, bash shell, allowlisted file I/O, and interactive process sessions in addition to LaunchAgent/Keychain coverage.
Async path-policy authorization is canonical-realpath based, preventing false denials such as macOS /var -> /private/var while retaining symlink escape protection.
Windows window-filter regression coverage uses an isolated WPF fixture instead of racing arbitrary runner windows.

Release-readiness CI performs a full Linux gate plus clean packaged-runtime smoke tests on Linux, Windows, and macOS; canonical candidates now include SHA256SUMS, release-manifest.json, and a CycloneDX SBOM while npm publication remains disabled.

Release candidates are independently re-verified before upload: tarball SHA256SUMS, manifest package/source/artifact/skill inventory, CycloneDX root identity, and private-package posture must all match.
Tag-triggered release readiness now fails before canonical packaging unless the Git tag is exactly v<package-version>; branch and PR readiness runs are intentional no-ops for that tag check.

SLSA and CycloneDX artifact attestations are baseline release functionality with write/OIDC permissions isolated to tag-scoped attestation work; GitHub v1.0.0 publication completed successfully after explicit owner authorization.
GitHub Release/npm publication is intentionally not automatic. Creating release tags, GitHub Releases, or publishing packages requires explicit owner authorization.

Windows structured-control CI now runs test/windows-control.test.ts on a real Windows runner; unnamed/default registry values support verified set/read/delete round-trips without weakening exact key or hive-root deletion protections.
Windows structured-control PowerShell JSON input now uses explicit UTF-8 stdin instead of child-process environment variables; real Windows CI verifies a >64 KiB Unicode registry mutation round-trip.

Windows user/machine environment PowerShell JSON input now uses explicit UTF-8 stdin, preventing secret-bearing environment values from being copied into the child process environment; real Windows CI verifies a ~32 KiB Unicode user-scope round-trip.

windows.service.control now rejects wildcard selectors before mutation and resolves exactly one case-insensitive service Name before applying start/stop/restart/startup operations via the resolved ServiceController; the stable MCP v1 input schema is unchanged.

windows.service.control now polls bounded postconditions after mutation: start/restart must converge to Running, stop to Stopped, and requested startup type must match final Win32_Service StartMode; real Windows CI verifies startup mutation on an isolated temporary service fixture.
Windows Event Log query output is bounded by per-field, per-message, and aggregate message budgets with explicit truncation metadata; real Windows CI verifies those bounds.

GitHub v1.0.0 was published successfully from tag/commit 98d040c284efad7f726c3d3ccaa1771d385ed60d. Release Readiness run 36890669730 passed Linux/Windows/macOS packaging, independent candidate verification, SLSA provenance, CycloneDX SBOM attestation, checksum re-verification, and GitHub Release publication; npm remains intentionally disabled.

There is no active unfinished v1.0 implementation or publication work. Future domain recipes, probes, performance tuning, and reproduced hardening are optional post-v1 backlog and should become active only when a concrete task is selected.
